entries.source:
Open a radius 1 rift in spacetime at the targeted location for %d turns, increasing in radius by 1 each turn to a maximum of %d.
		All caught within the rift are pulled towards the center and take %0.2f gravity damage.
The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
在目标地点开启半径1的时空裂缝，持续 %d 回合。每回合半径增加1，最大 %d。
		裂缝每回合对范围内的所有敌人造成 %0.2f 重力伤害，并将未通过物理豁免且未免疫击退的敌人朝中心牵引。
伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Even now, something compels you to sing.
			Dirge of Famine: Increases health regen by %d.
			Dirge of Conquest: Gives you part of a turn on critical (10%%) or kill (%d%%).
			Dirge of Pestilence: Shields you for %d when an enemy inflicts a detrimental effect on you (5 turn cooldown).
			You may only have one Dirge active at a time.
entries.target:
即便如今，仍有什么驱使着你歌唱。
			饥荒挽歌：增加生命回复 %d。
			征服挽歌：给予你暴击时 10%% 回合或杀戮时 %d%% 回合的时间。
			瘟疫挽歌：你受到非自身施加、且不属于“其他”类型的负面效果时获得 %d 的护盾（5 回合冷却）。
			你同时只能激活一种挽歌。

entries.source:
Creates a gravity spike in a radius of %d that moves all targets towards the spell's center and inflicts %0.2f physical (gravity) damage.
		Each target moved beyond the first increases the damage by %0.2f (up to a maximum of %0.2f bonus damage).
		Targets take reduced damage the further they are from the epicenter (20%% less per tile).
		The damage dealt will scale with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
在半径 %d 范围内制造一个重力钉刺，将所有目标牵引至法术中心，造成 %0.2f 物理（重力）伤害。
		从第二个单位起，每牵引一个单位将会使伤害增加 %0.2f (最多增加 %0.2f 额外伤害)。
		离法术中心越远，目标受到的伤害越少（伤害除以 1 + 距离格数 × 20%%）。
		受法术强度影响，伤害按比例加成。

entries.source:
When you avoid a melee blow while unarmed, you have a %d%% chance to throw the target to the ground.  If the throw lands, the target will take %0.2f damage and be dazed for 2 turns, or %0.2f damage and be stunned for 2 turns if the target is grappled.  You may attempt up to %0.1f throws per turn.
		The chance of throwing increases with your Accuracy, the damage scales with your Physical Power, and the number of attempts with your Strength and Dexterity.
entries.target:
当你空手闪避一次近战攻击时，有 %d%% 概率将目标摔倒。若投掷成功，未被抓取的目标受到 %0.2f 伤害并眩晕 2 回合；被抓取的目标则受到 %0.2f 伤害并震慑 2 回合。每回合最多尝试 %0.1f 次投掷。
		投掷概率随灵巧提高（投掷能否命中取决于你的命中与目标闪避），伤害随物理强度提高，尝试次数随力量和敏捷提高。

entries.source: Your back is as hard as stone. Each time that you are affected by a physical effect, your body hardens, making you immune to all other physical effects for 5 turns.
entries.target: 你的后背坚若磐石。当你受到物理负面状态（越层效果除外）影响时，你的身体会硬化，在 5 回合内对所有其他物理负面状态（越层效果除外）免疫。

entries.source:
By bringing the forces of entropy to bear on a target, you prophesize their inevitable doom. Each point in this talent unlocks additional prophecies. A target can only be affected by a single prophecy at a time.
Level 1: Prophecy of Ruin. Deals %0.2f damage on falling below 75%%, 50%% or 25%% of maximum life.
Level 3: Prophecy of Treason. %d%% chance each turn to attack an ally or themselves.
Level 5: Prophecy of Madness. Increases talent cooldowns by %d%%.
entries.target:
对目标释放熵能力量，你预言了它无可避免的末日。随着技能等级提升，你能解锁更多预言。同一目标不能同时处于两种预言下。
技能等级 1：毁灭预言。当生命值降至最大生命的 75%%、50%% 或 25%% 以下时，造成 %0.2f 伤害。
技能等级 3：背叛预言。目标每回合累积 %d%% 背叛进度（通过法术豁免时只累积一半），进度满时攻击一名相邻的生物（无论敌友），没有相邻生物时攻击自身。
技能等级 5：疯狂预言。增加 %d%% 技能冷却时间。

entries.source:
Utter a prophecy of the impending treachery of your target. For the next 6 turns, they will have a %d%% each turn to waste their turn attempting to attack an adjacent creature for 10%% weapon damage, or even themself if no creature is present.
		A target can only be affected by a single prophecy at a time.
entries.target:
对目标说出其即将背叛的预言。在接下来的 6 回合内，目标每回合累积 %d%% 背叛进度（初始进度随机；通过法术豁免时只累积一半），进度满时便浪费该回合，尝试攻击邻近单位并造成 10%% 武器伤害；如果没有其他单位，则会攻击自身。
		一个目标只能同时被一个预言影响。

entries.source: The target is doomed to treason. Each turn they have a %d%% chance to attack an adjacent creature.  If no creatures are adjacent they will attack themself.
entries.target: 目标被诅咒进入背叛状态。每回合累积 %d%% 背叛进度（通过法术豁免时只累积一半），进度满时攻击一个相邻生物；若周围没有相邻生物，则会攻击自身。

entries.source:
The target feels the echoes of all your light and dark damage for %d turns. 

Light damage slows the target by %0.2f%% per point of damage dealt for %d turns, up to a maximum of %d%% at %d damage.
Dark damage creates an effect at the tile for %d turns which deals %d%% of the damage dealt each turn. It will be refreshed as long as the target continues taking damage from it or another source while Twilit Echoes is active, dealing its remaining damage over the new duration as well as the new damage.
entries.target:
目标会感受到其所受的所有光系和暗影伤害的回响（不论伤害来源），持续 %d 回合。

每受到 1 点光系伤害，目标便会减速 %0.2f%%， 持续 %d 回合；减速上限为 %d%%， 累计受到 %d 点伤害时达到上限。
暗影伤害会在目标所在格生成一个初始持续 4 回合的效果；在暮光回响生效期间，目标仍在该格并再次受到暗影伤害（包括此效果本身造成的伤害）时，若该效果剩余时间不足 %d 回合，就会刷新持续时间，并将剩余伤害与新一轮伤害合并均摊。新一轮伤害每回合按该次暗影伤害的 %d%% 计算。

Light damage slows the target by %0.2f%% per point of damage dealt for %d turns, up to a maximum of %d%% at %d damage.
Dark damage creates an effect at the tile for %d turns which deals %d%% of the damage dealt each turn. It will be refreshed as long as the target continues taking damage from it or another source while Twilit Echoes is active, dealing its remaining damage over the new duration as well as the new damage.

每受到 1 点光系伤害，目标便会减速 %0.2f%%， 持续 %d 回合；减速上限为 %d%%， 累计受到 %d 点伤害时达到上限。
暗影伤害会在目标所在格生成一个初始持续 4 回合的效果；在暮光回响生效期间，目标仍在该格并再次受到暗影伤害（包括此效果本身造成的伤害）时，若该效果剩余时间不足 %d 回合，就会刷新持续时间，并将剩余伤害与新一轮伤害合并均摊。新一轮伤害每回合按该次暗影伤害的 %d%% 计算。

entries.source:
Quickly create a psionic-enhanced metal contraption that lures all your foes to it and reflects %d%% of the damage it takes to its attackers.
		The contraption will have %d life and last 5 turns.
		Damage, life, resists, and armor scale with your Steampower.
entries.target:
快速制造一个灵能强化的金属装置，吸引所有敌人攻击它，并将其所受伤害的 %d%% 反弹给攻击者。
		该装置拥有 %d 点生命值，持续 8 回合。
		其生命值、抗性和护甲随你的蒸汽强度提升。

entries.source: Deals %0.2f occult damage per turn and each time a talent is used, the caster regens one turn of a random cooldown.
entries.target: 每回合造成 %0.2f 玄机伤害；目标每次使用技能（攻击、射击、装填等基础动作除外）时，施加者一个随机冷却中科技法术（若没有则为法术）的冷却时间减少 1 回合。
